subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept this default-off Feishu `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing once real Feishu proof and a clean merge are supplied?
rationale: Source review supports the owner-boundary shape, but adding a user-facing config option and accepting the proof bar for Feishu API timing require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Pacing Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Feishu logs, terminal output, recording, or linked artifacts showing same-target pacing and distinct-target independence before merge.

options.title: Accept Mock-Seam Proof Explicitly
options.body: Maintainers may choose to merge on mocked runtime-seam proof and CI, accepting that live Feishu timing remains unproven.

options.title: Defer Or Reject New Config
options.body: Keep only the existing reactive retry behavior or move proactive queueing to the broader rate-limit design instead of adding this Feishu-specific config.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Pacing Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Feishu logs, terminal output, recording, or linked artifacts showing same-target pacing and distinct-target independence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained Feishu/Lark plugin owner candidate for Feishu-owned send behavior.
